title: PBS Copayment Reform: Replication Code
description: Data acquisition, cleaning, and analysis code for a natural-experiment evaluation of Australia's January 2023 PBS general patient copayment reduction ($42.50 to $30.00). Identification uses an event-study and triple-difference design, with first-stage, dose-response, de-seasonalisation, pre-period anchor, HonestDiD, placebo-in-time, distributional (equity), and 60-day-dispensing robustness checks. The reform produced no detectable change in dispensing.
